patterns.note: Full-bleed sections with high-contrast backgrounds (white, light peach, black) create distinct visual breaks and emphasize content blocks.
Dominant use of oversized, condensed, uppercase sans-serif for headlines creates a bold and assertive brand voice, paired with a more legible sans-serif for body text.
A vibrant, metallic product color palette (greens, purples, oranges, reds) is used against stark white or black backgrounds, with a warm peach accent for one key section.
The hero product image (green capsule) exhibits a subtle parallax effect, moving down and left relative to the viewport as the user scrolls down.
The primary navigation bar transforms from a transparent, taller state to a sticky, shorter bar with a solid white background and reduced padding after initial scroll.
Product carousels feature highly rendered, metallic 3D product models against a clean white background, emphasizing luxury and distinctiveness.

technique_notes: The site uses a scroll-triggered animation system where the hero product image moves with a subtle parallax effect, appearing to slide into view as the user scrolls down.
Sections are revealed with a subtle fade-in or slide-up effect as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic scrolling experience.
The global navigation bar dynamically shrinks in height and gains a solid background color once the user scrolls past the initial hero section, maintaining visibility and accessibility.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, condensed, uppercase headings (~4-5x body text) create a strong, almost aggressive visual hierarchy, with body text in a standard sans-serif.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (small corner radius on buttons, cards, and product images).
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, but tighter grids for product displays and testimonials.

standout: The site's standout feature is its audacious, almost confrontational use of oversized, condensed typography paired with highly rendered, metallic product imagery. This creates a distinctive brand identity that feels both luxurious and rebellious, moving beyond typical beauty industry aesthetics.
